_comment: Per-site staging hosts. A unit pulls its payload over SMB, so it must open
TCP 445 to whatever serves that payload -- and at a site, only a host on the
units' own VLAN qualifies. Declaring one here lets the orchestrator run
somewhere the units cannot reach: it builds locally, rsyncs to the relay, and
hands the unit the relay's address instead of its own.
A site with NO entry keeps pulling from the orchestrator itself, exactly as
before -- which is what the bench and the dev VM want. A malformed entry is a
hard error rather than a silent skip, because silently falling back points the
unit at the orchestrator again and looks like config that was not picked up.
'creds_key' selects the vault/creds.json block the unit authenticates to the
share with; the relay's share is read-only and uses the same account as
Setup for a new relay is in docs/provisioning-server-setup.md; the layout it
expects under 'root' is hosts/ (served), payload/ and vendor-view/.
